name: MG Reason Boy
consignor: Burns Ranch, Agent for M&G Farms
sire: By DASHA GOOD REASON SI 93 (2019). 4 wins, $264,483, fnl in Los Alamitos Two Million Fut. [G1], Los Alamitos Super Derby [G1], Brad McKinzie Winter Champ. S. [G1]. Half-brother to HEZA DASHA FIRE SI 105 (Champion), IMA FEARLESS HERO SI 92 (Champion), DASHA DYNASTY SI 94, HEZA FEARLESS DASHER SI 91, JUST A DASHA HERO SI 92. His first foals are yearlings of 2026. Son of champion GOOD REASON SA SI 102; sire of 13 stakes winners, including JESS GOOD CANDY SI 96 (Champion, $2,014,703, All American Futurity [G1]).
